about: A WPA2 network named on 6 GHz by its bands (0086): the renderer refuses it, so the agent applies nothing, and the manager holds the config before that. What it would render keeps it off 6 GHz all the same.
errors: network.home: 6 GHz takes WPA3 or OWE only, not wpa2-psk; take 6g out of its bands, or make it wpa3-sae, wpa2-wpa3 or owe
